definition: to escape from a place you were kept
description: A smiling young woman in a long silver satin dress climbs barefoot over a high old stone wall covered in ivy at an evening garden party, holding the top with one hand, her silver high-heeled sandals in her teeth. She swings her leg over, takes the sandals in her hand and sits on top of the wall, laughing and touching her hair. Below, on the lawn in front of a large country house, guests in black suits and dark dresses stand by a white tent and watch her as the sun sets behind the trees.
